title: A proper birational morphism of integral curves is finite
statement: Let $k$ be a field [def-weil-field], let $C$ and $E$ be integral [def-pc-integral-scheme] separated schemes of finite type over $k$, each of dimension $1$ [def-kun-topological-krull-dimension], and let $p:E\to C$ be a proper [def-weil-proper-morphism] dominant $k$-morphism inducing an isomorphism $k(C)\xrightarrow{\sim}k(E)$ of function fields [def-sc-function-field]. Then $p$ is finite [def-weil-finite-integral-morphism].

source.place: Tag 0AB7 (lemma-finite-in-codim-1), especially the hypotheses and proof: for each point of the one-dimensional target, properness and the finite generic field extension give finiteness over a neighbourhood; finiteness is local on the target.

proof.text: The actual generic stalk map of p is surjective by the birational hypothesis, so it is finite as a ring homomorphism (RingHom.Finite.of_surjective). Properness supplies LocallyOfFiniteType p. Apply [lem-trf-birational-curve-quasifinite] with the given dimension-one, integral, separated, finite-type and dominance hypotheses and this finite generic stalk map. This proves p.IsQuasiFiniteAtPoint x for every x, hence p.IsLocallyQuasiFinite in [pqf-def-quasifinite].

source.place: Tag 0AB6 (lemma-quasi-finite-in-codim-1), condition (1), specialized by lem-trf-birational-curve-quasifinite; a surjective ring map is generated by 1 as a module.

proof.text: Use Scheme.Hom.isLocallyQuasiFinite_iff in WeilConjectures.AlgebraicGeometry.QuasiFiniteMorphismComparison to convert the Stacks pointwise condition of [pqf-def-quasifinite] to Mathlib's LocallyQuasiFinite p. Together with the assumed IsProper p, apply [pqf-lem-proper-lqf-finite], IsFinite.of_isProper_of_locallyQuasiFinite, to obtain IsFinite p.

source.place: Tag 02LS, proper and locally quasi-finite implies finite.
